text.zh-CN:
痔是肛门内外血管组织肿胀形成的肿块，可有便后鲜红出血、瘙痒或脱出。

- 内痔可能出血而不痛，外部肿块可疼痛；症状程度各不相同。
- 便血不能仅凭颜色认定是痔，需要结合检查排除其他原因。
text.en:
Haemorrhoids are swollen vascular tissue inside or around the anus, causing bright bleeding, itching or prolapse.

- Internal piles may bleed without pain, while external lumps may hurt.
- Blood colour alone cannot establish haemorrhoids; other causes may need exclusion.

text.zh-CN:
局部压力和排便习惯会影响发生机会。

- 便秘、排便用力和长时间坐便容易加重。
- 怀孕、年龄增加、体重超标或重体力搬举也是相关因素。
- 原因并非完全明确，不是简单等于不爱干净。
text.en:
Pressure and bowel habits affect risk.

- Constipation, straining and prolonged toilet sitting can worsen piles.
- Pregnancy, ageing, excess weight and heavy lifting are associated factors.
- Causes are not fully understood and do not simply reflect poor hygiene.

text.zh-CN:
明显出血或感染表现需要及时升级就医。

- 持续流血、大量出血或大血块，立即急诊；伴晕厥更应急救。
- 严重肛门疼痛也需急诊评估。
- 发热寒战、脓液或全身不适，应尽快求医，不能只涂痔疮膏。
text.en:
Significant bleeding or infection signs need urgent care.

- Continuous or heavy bleeding or large clots warrants emergency assessment, especially with faintness.
- Severe anal pain also requires urgent evaluation.
- Fever, chills, pus or systemic illness needs prompt advice rather than cream alone.

text.zh-CN:
反复或新出现的症状应确认原因。

- 家庭护理后无改善、越来越重或反复发生，预约全科或肛肠科。
- 首次或原因不明的便血即使不痛也需评估。
- 就诊说明出血量、排便变化及抗凝药使用，避免只说有痔疮。
text.en:
New or recurrent symptoms need cause assessment.

- Book review if home care fails, symptoms worsen or episodes recur.
- New unexplained rectal bleeding needs assessment even when painless.
- Describe amount, bowel changes and anticoagulant use rather than simply reporting piles.

text.zh-CN:
检查目的既是确认痔，也是不漏掉其他病变。

- 医生询问出血与排便关系并检查肛周，按需进行肛门或直肠检查。
- 若便血持续或伴其他异常，可能需要进一步肠道评估。
- 有外部肿块不能证明全部出血都来自它。
text.en:
Examination confirms piles and considers other disease.

- Assessment includes bleeding in relation to stools and examination around or inside the anus as appropriate.
- Persistent bleeding or additional abnormalities may need further bowel investigation.
- A visible external lump does not prove all bleeding comes from it.

text.zh-CN:
便血、痛和痒有不同可能。

- 肛裂常与排便时疼痛相关，肛周感染也可形成疼痛肿块。
- 肠道炎症或其他病变也可能出血，持续排便习惯改变需说明。
- 不要因已知痔疮就忽略新出现的异常。
text.en:
Bleeding, pain and itching have several possible causes.

- An anal fissure may hurt with defecation, while infection can cause a painful lump.
- Bowel inflammation or other lesions can bleed; report persistent changes in bowel habits.
- Known piles do not explain every new symptom automatically.

text.zh-CN:
先减少排便损伤，再按需要选择操作。

- 软化大便、减少用力和局部护理可改善不少轻症。
- 持续症状可考虑套扎、注射或其他门诊治疗，使痔组织缩小。
- 较大或其他治疗无效时可能需手术，方案结合类型及个人情况。
text.en:
Reduce bowel trauma first, then consider procedures if needed.

- Softer stools, less straining and local care improve many mild cases.
- Persistent symptoms may need banding, injection or other outpatient treatment to shrink tissue.
- Large or resistant piles may need surgery tailored to the type and person.

text.zh-CN:
药物缓解症状，但不一定消除脱出。

- 药膏可短期减轻痒痛，便秘时可咨询适合的缓泻剂。
- 含可待因止痛药会加重便秘；NHS建议痔出血时避免布洛芬。
- 外用复方产品按说明使用，持续出血不应反复自行换药掩盖。
text.en:
Medicines relieve symptoms but may not resolve prolapse.

- Creams can temporarily reduce itch or pain, and suitable laxatives can treat constipation.
- Codeine-containing painkillers worsen constipation; NHS advises avoiding ibuprofen when piles are bleeding.
- Use combination creams as directed and do not mask persistent bleeding by repeatedly switching products.

text.zh-CN:
饮食目标是让大便柔软易排。

- 逐渐增加蔬菜、水果、全谷物等纤维，并按自身情况补足水分。
- 突然大量加纤维可能胀气，可渐进调整。
- 不需统一禁掉所有辛辣食物；若某种食物明显刺激自己，可减少。
text.en:
Diet aims for soft, easily passed stools.

- Increase vegetables, fruit and whole-grain fibre gradually with suitable fluids.
- A sudden large fibre increase can cause bloating, so adjust gradually.
- There is no universal need to ban all spicy food; reduce foods that clearly trigger your symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
避免用力和反复摩擦。

- 有便意及时如厕，不久坐刷手机，也不用力憋挤。
- 温水清洁或坐浴后轻拍干燥，避免粗暴擦拭。
- 短时隔布冷敷可减轻不适；不要自行刺破或剪除肿块。
text.en:
Avoid straining and repeated friction.

- Use the toilet when needed without prolonged phone use or forceful pushing.
- Clean with warm water or bathe, then pat dry rather than rubbing.
- Brief wrapped cold packs may help; do not puncture or cut a lump yourself.

text.zh-CN:
妊娠和其他用药会影响处理。

- 孕期常见痔症状，应优先排便护理并核对药膏或缓泻剂适用性。
- 服用抗凝药者出血需要告诉医生，不自行停抗凝药。
- 老人新发便血或排便变化应评估，不能只凭常见就认为无害。
text.en:
Pregnancy and other treatment affect choices.

- During pregnancy, prioritise bowel care and check cream or laxative suitability.
- Report bleeding while taking anticoagulants without stopping them yourself.
- New bleeding or bowel changes in older adults needs assessment rather than being dismissed as common.

text.zh-CN:
轻症可数日改善，也可能复发。

- 护理后仍不改善或反复发作，需要确认类型和下一步处理。
- 手术或门诊操作后仍可能复发，需继续保持良好的排便习惯。
- 治疗后严重痛、发热或大量出血需及时联系团队。
text.en:
Mild symptoms can improve in days but may recur.

- Persistent or repeated problems need reassessment and a next-step plan.
- Piles can recur after procedures, so continue good bowel habits.
- Severe pain, fever or heavy bleeding after treatment needs prompt contact.

text.zh-CN:
多数痔症状不危及生命，持续不适或出血仍需要处理。

- 反复疼痛、瘙痒和渗液可影响生活及皮肤状态。
- 较多或长期出血需要评估失血影响，并确认真正来源。
- 剧痛、脓液或发热可能提示需要另行处理的问题，不继续普通自护。
text.en:
Most symptoms are not life-threatening; persistent discomfort or bleeding still needs care.

- Repeated pain, itching and discharge affect comfort and surrounding skin.
- Substantial or ongoing bleeding needs assessment of blood loss and its true source.
- Severe pain, pus or fever may indicate a problem needing separate treatment.

text.zh-CN:
改善排便习惯有助减少复发。

- 保持适量纤维和水分，及时处理便秘。
- 不长时间坐便、不屏气用力，活动和体重管理按自身能力安排。
- 出现新便血时仍需评估。
text.en:
Better bowel habits help reduce recurrence.

- Maintain suitable fibre and fluids and address constipation.
- Avoid prolonged toilet sitting and straining; use suitable activity and weight management.
- New bleeding still needs assessment.

limitations.zh-CN: 面向普通读者的扩充医学信息草稿，已核读所列官方资料的相关章节；逐项独立论证、地区适用性核准及医学签审尚未完成，不构成个体诊断或处方。
limitations.en: Expanded educational draft based on inspected official patient-information sections. Independent claim verification, regional applicability review and clinical sign-off remain pending; this is not an individual diagnosis or prescription.
